posts.name: BlueHairedMeerkat
posts.cooked:
All the rules text is written on the cards; you could play with a lookup table, but that would be slower and less engaging. And less pretty. And would require Peter to send you a table of all the card text.

The better question is, why would you purchase a regular deck of cards instead of this?
